themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously, make decisions, and interact with systems or data to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content detailing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, often integrated into IDEs.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing platforms, software, or specific AI functionalities used to facilitate or enhance various research processes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: This theme covers AI applications that condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to automate, enhance, or analyze usability testing processes and results.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Content exploring AI's role in the design process, from ideation and prototyping to generating design assets and analyzing design effectiveness.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles examining the behavior, impact, safety, and user interaction with AI-powered chatbots.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: This theme covers research and discussion on how AI affects jobs, employment, and the skills required in the workforce.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, contrast, and assess the performance, features, and value of different AI tools.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Content on how AI is applied to product development, roadmapping, feature prioritization, and market analysis.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
